steps.en: Clone the repo and build the target for your hardware
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，按自己的硬件选一个目标编译

steps.en: Download one of the project's own model files
steps.zh: 下载项目自己产出的模型文件

steps.en: Fetches about 81 GiB into gguf/, resumable, and links it as the default model
steps.zh: 把约 81 GiB 下到 gguf/，可断点续传，并设为默认模型

steps.en: Start the server with the context size you can afford
steps.zh: 按内存余量定上下文长度，启动服务

steps.en: Loads the model on the GPU and serves OpenAI- and Anthropic-style APIs on 127.0.0.1:8000
steps.zh: 载入模型，在本机 8000 端口提供 OpenAI／Anthropic 接口

steps.en: Point your coding agent at the local address
steps.zh: 把编程智能体指向本机地址

steps.en: Keeps the conversation state so a resent history only costs its new tail
steps.zh: 记住对话状态，重发的历史只需处理新增的尾部

value.en: A frontier open model drives your coding agent from your own Mac, Spark or Strix Halo, with no hosted endpoint involved
value.zh: 前沿开源模型在你自己的 Mac、Spark 或 Strix Halo 上驱动编程智能体，全程不经过任何云端接口

sources: README.md Start Here (git clone; build table: make / make cuda-spark / make strix-halo / make cuda-generic; ./download_model.sh ds4f-q2; downloads go in gguf/, repeat to resume)
README.md Everyday Use (./ds4-server --ctx 32768; default model ds4flash.gguf is a link updated by main-model downloads; server listens at http://127.0.0.1:8000)
docs/SERVER.md APIs (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/completions, /v1/messages) and Disk KV cache (live token prefix, then disk prefixes, prefill only the new suffix)
